pages.text: $(t3)Tier 3$() unlocks $(bold)Mekanism$() - osmium renders and the apex machine roster opens. The keystone reward is $(bold)5x ore$(): the four-stage chain $(bold)Enrichment -> Purification -> Injection -> Crystallization$() turns one ore into five ingots' worth of output.

pages.title: Feeding the chain
pages.text: The 5x chain is power-hungry. The scalable T3 answer is $(bold)ethylene$(): farmed crops -> Bio Fuel -> a Pressurized Reaction Chamber -> a Gas-Burning Generator. Automated farming is effectively required - that is by design.

pages.title: Banking T3 tokens
pages.text: Mekanism is the densest token tier: $(bold)Gas-Burning Generator$() $(t3)100$(), Basic Smelting Factory $(t3)80$(), Purification Chamber $(t3)70$(), Enrichment Chamber $(t3)60$() each.$(br2)Bank $(t3)2000$() total to reach $(t4)Tier 4$(). Full writeup: $(l:icraft:mods_t3/mekanism)Mekanism$(/l).$(br2)$(bold)Next: get ethylene burning before you scale the chain — power first, then factories.$()
